summary: This note is a short biography of John Gould Veitch, an English amateur footballer who lived from 19 July 1869 to 3 October 1914. He played for the Corinthian club during the 1890s. His single England appearance came in 1894 at inside left, where he scored a hat trick.
one_line: John Gould Veitch was an English amateur footballer who played for Corinthian in the 1890s and scored a hat trick in his only England appearance in 1894.
